$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of .github/branch-protection.json, the committed branch rules. Boundary: shape only; a human applies the rules in GitHub settings or with the REST call. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0012 (code host and CI); GitHub REST 'Update branch protection' for the `rules` fields.
title: .github/branch-protection.json
description: Branch protection for one branch. `rules` is the request body of GitHub's PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection; `comment` and `branch` are this file's own wrapper.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. VS Code maps the file in .vscode/settings.json, so the API payload stays unchanged.

comment.description: How to apply the rules. Not sent to GitHub.

rules.description: The REST request body. GitHub requires the four nullable keys to be present.
rules.$comment: Only fields GitHub documents are typed; others stay allowed so a new GitHub field is not an editor error.

required_status_checks.description: Status checks that must pass before merging; null disables them.

strict.description: Require the branch to be up to date with the base before merging.

enforce_admins.description: Apply the rules to administrators too.

required_pull_request_reviews.description: Review requirements; null allows merging without a review.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed.

require_code_owner_reviews.description: Require a review from a CODEOWNERS owner.

required_approving_review_count.description: Approvals needed before merging (GitHub allows 0 to 6).

require_last_push_approval.description: The last push must be approved by someone other than its author.

restrictions.description: Who may push; null means anyone with write access.

required_linear_history.description: Forbid merge commits (squash or rebase only).

allow_force_pushes.description: Allow force pushes to the branch.

allow_deletions.description: Allow the branch to be deleted.

block_creations.description: Block creating branches that match the rule.

required_conversation_resolution.description: Every review thread must be resolved before merging.

allow_fork_syncing.description: Let forks sync a locked branch.
